rows.Kwic: 不思善、不思惡，那箇是明上座本來面目？

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xishan Liang (西山亮禪師語錄), public case commentary. Huineng is the exact speaker of the stored question asking Huiming which is his original face when not thinking good or evil. Huiming is the named addressee and awakening respondent; Xishan Liang is the later master who raises, interjects on, and finally questions the case.
